pre_execution_audit_repair.reason: Independent red-team review found that calibration beta hyperparameters must be selected inside each calibration inner-fit, that each reported policy must physically replay its own candidate shell, and that heldout context and policy APIs should receive stripped observable-only records. The repair changes no data cells, risk score, threshold quantile, accuracy gate, or decision threshold.
repairs: Each calibration inner fold now rebuilds split-correct upstream contexts and fit-only beta targets, selects beta hyperparameters inside that inner-fit, and predicts only its inner-heldout block.

Every beta-hyperparameter selection fold also rebuilds upstream contexts and targets using only that selection-fold fit, preventing its heldout block from entering beta-training features through the supervised upstream stack.
Every policy arm physically replays its own 2A+2AT candidate shell; continuation, restart, Zero-K2, and Zero-K4 receipts are measured at exact operator call sites and must equal their logical ledger.

Heldout context construction and policy execution receive observable-only records without truth, truth gradients, gates, or reference metrics; process-level never-read remains unproven because observations are generated from the already-open simulation truth in the same process.

pre_result_execution_repair.reason: The first detached execution stopped while constructing the deepest nested upstream selection because repeated block holdouts exhausted the remaining fit roster. No policy prediction, threshold, score, metric, or scientific result was generated or inspected.
pre_result_execution_repair.repair: Replace recursive upstream cross-fitting with a finite split-local fit: select upstream hyperparameters using only the current fit, fit only on that fit, permit in-sample representations for rows that remain in the fit, and predict every row scored at that level strictly out of sample. Every beta-selection and calibration level rebuilds this split, so its heldout target remains absent from both upstream and beta fitting.
unchanged: 75 data cells and five outer folds
residual score and grouped lower-quantile threshold
policy actions and exact A/A^T ledger

pre_result_reference_assertion_repair.failed_run_boundary: All five outer folds completed, then the run stopped before durable publication because an invalid reference-arm assertion required Zero-K4 to pass all eight candidate gates.
pre_result_reference_assertion_repair.reason: Zero-K4 is self-referential only for the four no-harm ratios. The other four gates compare Zero-K4 against the distinct equal-call Zero-K2 control, so they are not identities and may legitimately fail. Conversely, Zero-K2 is self-referential only for the four equal-call ratios.
pre_result_reference_assertion_repair.repair: Replace the invalid all-eight-gate assertion with arm-specific identity checks: every Zero-K4 no-harm ratio must equal one within numerical tolerance, every Zero-K2 equal-call ratio must equal one within numerical tolerance, and both reference arms must retain their exact measured call receipts. Keep all eight candidate gates, policy decisions, data cells, folds, thresholds, predictions, and cost rules unchanged.
unchanged: 75 data cells and five outer folds
one-frame embargo and split-local upstream fitting
candidate model, hyperparameters, predictions, and residual threshold rule
all eight matched-accuracy gates applied to candidate and gated policies
all policy actions and exact A/A^T ledgers

scientific_question: Can a deployment-visible residual gate preserve all eight matched-accuracy checks in all 75 already-open Case3 cells while retaining a lower average exact A/A^T budget than always running Zero-CGLS K4?

validated_parent.known_failure_boundary: All seven best-arm failures violate only observation no-harm versus Zero-K4. This observation motivates v84 but may not choose an outer-heldout threshold.

candidate.representation: the unchanged v83 four spatial-mask directions around a split-correct v80 base
candidate.outer_fold_hyperparameters: selected only inside the current outer-fit by the unchanged v83 nested beta selection

strict_nested_calibration.purpose: produce one candidate residual score for every outer-fit row without using that row in its own upstream or beta fit
strict_nested_calibration.upstream_rule: at every outer, calibration, and beta-selection split, select v80 hyperparameters using only that split's fit, fit only on that fit, use in-sample upstream representations only for rows that remain training rows at that level, and predict the split heldout strictly out of sample; do not recursively cross-fit the current fit after its labels are already confined to training
strict_nested_calibration.beta_rule: for each calibration inner fold, rebuild split-correct contexts, construct targets only on that inner-fit, select beta hyperparameters only inside that inner-fit, refit on that inner-fit, and predict the inner heldout; separately select and refit on all outer-fit for the outer-heldout query

primary_risk_gate.threshold_per_outer_fold: 75th percentile of the per-truth-group maximum inner-OOF score over outer-fit
primary_risk_gate.truth_group_aggregation: maximum across the three known geometries
primary_risk_gate.decision: accept K1 exactly when score <= threshold
forbidden_inputs: any of the eight gate values or pass labels
Zero-K2 or Zero-K4 field, residual, or metric
frame index, snapshot time, or temporal neighbor
primary_risk_gate.metadata_note: Frame index and cell identifiers may be written after the decision for audit joins, but the score, threshold fit, accept decision, beta predictor, and fallback action APIs must not receive them.

gated_true_cgls_k2_continuation.rejected_action: continue the exact CGLS recurrence from the candidate K1 state using one new A^T residual action and one new A direction action

gated_restart_zero_k4.rejected_action: retain the already-spent candidate 2A+2AT in the ledger and then run an independent Zero-CGLS K4 at 4A+4AT

success_and_failure.primary_safety_requirement: each reported gated arm passes all eight checks in all 75 cells
success_and_failure.resource_proxy_requirement: mean A calls and mean AT calls are each strictly below 4 and every logical receipt matches the fixed branch ledger
success_and_failure.report: per fold, scenario, truth group, cell, acceptance, fallback, all eight gates, harm, and exact-call totals
success_and_failure.continuation_pass: record opened-development headroom for an observable-gated 2-or-3-pair policy and freeze a previously unopened public reacting-flow condition as the next external gate
success_and_failure.restart_pass: record opened-development headroom for a fail-closed K1-or-Zero-K4 policy only if its average exact budget remains below always-K4
success_and_failure.any_unsafe_accept_or_no_average_saving: close that policy arm without a larger model rescue
